Issue: API startup unconditionally migrates and executes the full demo IdentitySeeder, including fixed accounts and password resets
Recommended action: Split roles, bootstrap owner and demo seed; prohibit demo seed in Production; move migration to release task

Issue: Login has no dedicated rate limit, failed attempts do not lock the account and minimum password length is 6
Recommended action: Add per-IP and per-account auth limits, Identity lockout policy, stronger minimum length and tests for login/Magic Link/MFA/passkey endpoints

Issue: Stripe special CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID placeholder is URL encoded, so the customer success page remains in Confirming even though the backend later becomes Paid
Recommended action: Append the literal Stripe placeholder without QueryHelpers encoding; add an integration assertion on the exact SuccessUrl and result-page recovery

Issue: Frontend CD sets VITE_API_BASE_URL empty and does not inject legal identity variables; auth refresh/logout requests are relative /api paths
Recommended action: Choose a single production routing model; configure CloudFront API/WebSocket origins or use one API base helper for every request; validate VITE_LEGAL_* during build

Issue: Login form is prefilled with owner@dineflow.com and ChangeMe123! in normal source
Recommended action: Default to empty fields; expose demo autofill only behind an explicit development-only feature flag

Issue: npm production dependency tree reports 13 advisories including 8 high
Recommended action: Upgrade direct dependencies and lockfile; review reachability; rerun build, tests and audit

Issue: NuGet reports high advisories in Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory 8.0.0 and System.Text.Json 8.0.4
Recommended action: Upgrade Microsoft/.NET package patch versions consistently and retest

Issue: Standard npm test fails under the machine default Node because experimental webstorage leaves localStorage unusable
Evidence: 16 failures in 4 files under default runner; 173 pass with Node 24 and --no-experimental-webstorage
Recommended action: Pin Node with .nvmrc/Volta and make the package test command deterministic

Issue: Frontend lint fails with 77 errors and 9 warnings, including React Hooks issues
Recommended action: Fix correctness-related Hook errors first, then make CI block new lint errors

Issue: Frontend and backend CI only build and do not run tests, lint or vulnerability checks
Recommended action: Add frontend test/lint and backend test stages; archive results; fail on agreed vulnerability threshold

Issue: Four PostgreSQL concurrency tests are skipped, including MFA first update and counter reversal/refund races
Recommended action: Provide PostgreSQL test service in CI and make these mandatory before payment release

Issue: Displayed restaurant ABN 12345678901 fails ABN checksum and refund email 2@gmail.com is not release-ready
Recommended action: Validate ABN checksum and perform human/ABR confirmation; replace all test legal/support data before trial

Issue: Market Arancini displays a Chicken Wings image while allergen, may-contain and cross-contact fields are empty
Recommended action: Make publication validation require restaurant confirmation of image, dietary claims and allergen/cross-contact information

Issue: Free-text allergy notes can contain health information but collection purpose, access and retention are not separately explained
Recommended action: Minimise collection; add a concise sensitive-information notice/consent where legally appropriate; restrict staff access and retention

Issue: Retention periods are documented but no scheduled enforcement or irreversible de-identification job was found
Recommended action: Implement and test retention jobs, legal holds, backup lifecycle and deletion evidence

Issue: Privacy request APIs exist, but a complete customer submission/status UI and admin processing workflow are not present
Recommended action: Add accessible request entry, identity verification, admin queue, SLA/status/reply and audit trail

Issue: Order can remain Pending while payment is Paid; operational meaning and automatic acceptance need explicit verification
Recommended action: Define state machine and expected transition after payment; alert on paid-but-stale order state

Issue: Denied Staff and Customer routes silently redirect to profile without an access-denied explanation
Recommended action: Show a short 403/access-denied state while preserving no-data-leak behaviour

Issue: At least one dashboard snapshot had no semantic H1 and keyboard/screen-reader flows are not covered
Recommended action: Add unique H1 and automated axe/keyboard checks for critical routes

Issue: Production build warns about large chunks; main JS is about 1.83 MB and CSS about 762 KB before gzip
Recommended action: Route-split admin areas, audit large dependencies and define a bundle budget

Issue: QZ connection passed but no physical print, outage recovery or 30-50 order endurance test was executed
Recommended action: Run controlled first-store hardware acceptance and record ticket/queue evidence

Issue: RDS restore and ECS/RDS/API/Stripe webhook alert delivery were not demonstrated
Recommended action: Perform one restore rehearsal and alert-fire drill before accepting real orders
